intro: Own1 is a personal AI computer you keep at home or in the office. Nexy is the assistant on it, and now on your laptop, your phone and in the cloud too, all connected to your own Own1 over a private network.

facts.label: Nexy Engine: one of the smallest AI agent engines
ways to run Nexy: Own1, Mac, Android, cloud, Docker
open-source apps one click away on OwnXOS
AI models bundled: Nexy uses the ones you already run

news.title: A new AI agent engine, built small
news.text: Written in Rust, it is one of the smallest agent engines around: a single 3.5 MB program that leaves the machine's memory to the AI model. Open source.

news.title: Nexy on your Mac and your phone
news.text: New desktop and Android apps run Nexy on your own device, with signed automatic updates.

news.title: Open your Own1 from anywhere
news.text: The apps reach your Own1 over an encrypted network and sign in with a key only you hold. No router changes, no third-party cloud in the middle.

news.title: Works with the AI you already have
news.text: Nexy runs on Ollama or LM Studio, the most popular ways to run AI models at home, instead of bundling its own.

news.title: A private AI machine for every user
news.text: In the hosted beta, each person's agent runs in its own isolated virtual machine.

news.title: AI employees on one box
news.text: Nexy Teams staffs a project with AI specialists that research, design, write and build, and nothing is published until the owner approves.

tracks.name: Private network
